profile.headline: U.S. Citizen | Ex-Microsoft | Software Engineer | AI Agents, Backend & Platform Engineering
profile.summary:
When services go down, incident management still has to work. At Microsoft, I built and operated backend services that helped make that possible.

I'm a software engineer with 7+ years across distributed systems, cloud infrastructure, and rail communications. I take services from design through production operations. In AI-assisted engineering, I define the problem, set acceptance criteria, and validate what ships.

I'm interested in backend and platform roles with teams that value reliable software and sustainable engineering practices.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Built and operated C#/.NET services handling tens of thousands of requests per hour within Microsoft's incident management platform. Managed data, operations, and telemetry across Azure Data Explorer clusters. Owned infrastructure for the platform's deployment, validation, and monitoring in U.S. federal clouds.
positions.insights: Design Patterns, Software Development and +7 skills

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Developed C++ messaging software for interoperable rail communications and built Go/Kubernetes automation for deployment, backup restoration, and upgrades. Improved automated testing through Ruby REST applications.
positions.insights: Design Patterns, Go (Programming Language) and +7 skills

positions.title: Programming Lab Assistant
positions.description:
Distinguished as one of only nine students selected by the Department of Computer Science and Engineering to serve as a Programming Lab Assistant.

Provided comprehensive tutoring and mentorship, enhancing student proficiency in key areas such as data structures, algorithmic thinking, object-oriented programming, and design patterns.

Facilitated deeper comprehension of software development practices and systems analysis among the student body.
positions.insights: Design Patterns, Software Development and +7 skills

honors.title: Certificate of Appreciation
honors.description: Recognized by fellow co-workers and senior executives for going above and beyond the call of duty in achieving the 2018 company stretched goals.

volunteerExperiences.description:
✅ Collaborated with system administrators to ensure robust user authentication and authorization protocols on Windows Server environments.

✅ Monitored and documented software bug statuses effectively during critical system upgrade operations.

✅ Contributed to cost savings of $2,000 by skillfully diagnosing and resolving issues with existing IT equipment during the computer lab’s upgrade phase.

✅ Facilitated monthly educational forums at Evergreen Hospital in Kirkland, Washington, enhancing community health literacy and engagement.

✅ Advocated for individuals with mental health challenges, guiding them towards supportive resources provided by the National Alliance on Mental Illness (NAMI).

✅ Recipient of the Outstanding Achievement Award, recognizing exceptional contributions to mental health awareness and support initiatives.
